equivalent.scope: final class StatusIndicator > func scheduleErrorReset(for runID: UUID)
equivalent.reason: In scheduleErrorReset. The reset task it would cancel cannot act any more: when it wakes, errorResetElapsed requires errorResetRunID to equal its run, and the next line sets errorResetRunID to the new run (cancelErrorReset sets it to nil). No run schedules two resets: finishRunFailed and failRunStart each run once per run, and ResultActions passes a fresh UUID. Without the cancel the replaced task only sleeps on and then returns.
